texts.value: Mediates the uptake of pyruvate into mitochondria to maintain the balance between glycolysis and oxidative phosphorylation (PubMed:22628558, PubMed:26253029, PubMed:27317664, PubMed:29472561, PubMed:40044865, PubMed:40101766, PubMed:35278701). Belongs to the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) (TC 2.A.105) family
